visualCharacteristics.purpose: Breadcrumb trail at the top of a page showing the path from the site root to the current page

contentPattern.structure: A list of links (or one link / text per cell or paragraph). Linked items become ancestor crumbs; trailing plain text is the current page. Use the alt option for trails that end on a linked item with a trailing separator

reuseGuidance: Use once at the top of interior pages. Do not use for in-page jump links (anchor-nav) or section navigation (section-nav).
